lore_anchors.definition: A legendary sacred wood that is the main material for Han Li's Green Bamboo Flying Swords.
The signature magic treasure set Han Li plans to refine, known for their immense power and complexity.
A Daoist cultivation method where a cultivator immerses themselves in mortal society to strengthen their mind and understanding of human experience.
